invented.quote: That's how I pay my mortgage, my mate, my fuel, and my insurance.
invented.why: The brief does not state that the speaker has a mortgage or employs a mate.

invented.quote: This proposal would last three years, not one.
invented.why: The brief does not state how long the 2016 limit cut lasted, only that bookings dropped the next season.

invented.quote: People don't drive to the coast and pay for a charter to take home two fish.
invented.why: The brief does not state that customers drive to the coast, and the survey shows at least 12 customers would still book the same number of trips with a two-fish limit.

invented.quote: A cut that falls just as hard on the smallest share of the harvest
invented.why: The brief states charter boats land 9% and private boats land 80%, which leaves 11% unaccounted for, so the brief does not show that charter boats have the smallest share of the harvest.
